name: Shaanxi Energy Investment Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shaanxi Energy Investment Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in thermal power generation and coal production in China. The company involves in the comprehensive utilization of solid and industrial waste; power maintenance; software and information technology services; electricity trading; power development; steam heat supply; cargo transportation; new energy battery swapping; energy storage technology services; coal mining and transportation; and power generation equipment testing and maintenance activities.
